description.value: Wheelies Cafe is a sandwich-focused eatery in Victoria, BC, offering both dine-in and takeout with outdoor seating — a straightforward stop for a touring cyclist looking for a quick meal. The name 'Wheelies' hints at a possible two-wheeled theme, though whether that extends to bicycles or motorcycles is unconfirmed. Its outdoor seating makes it a comfortable spot to rest before continuing a ride.
